title: cost-optimization-autotune-defaults-batching-caching-quant-uecon-tooling
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Implements autotune defaults for batching and caching, adds quantization profile selection heuristics, and ships unit-econ tooling for cost impact analysis. Backwards compatible runtime defaults and a migration guide included.
description: This PR wires together three pieces of work toward automated cost-optimization: 1) sensible defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching at the serving runtime level so new deployments get immediate unit-econ benefits, 2) quantization profile selection heuristics (per-model recommendations surfaced via the model registry) plus safe fallbacks when accuracy regressions are detected, and 3) unit-economics tooling that computes per-request token cost estimates and suggests autoscaling/route policies to hit target cost-per-inference. Motivation: customers repeatedly choose suboptimal batching/cache settings or conservative quantization, increasing per-token costs. This change reduces ops burden and improves out-of-box inference economics. The implementation is careful to preserve latency SLOs and includes canary rollout gates and eval-driven quality checks.

merge-bot: Merged via squash on 2025-12-02 by automation. Merge commit message: 'autoscale: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling'
notes_for_release: Enable autotune defaults behind feature flag 'autotune.defaults.enabled' for hosted by default. Dedicated/Private clusters: defaults applied only on upgrade when operator sets 'applyAutotuneDefaults=true'. Quant profiles are advisory; customers can opt-out per-model. Recommend monitoring unit_econ_overview dashboard and set alert if cost-per-token increases >3% during rollout.
migration_guide: See docs/migration/2025-11-autotune-migration.md for steps. Key actions: 1) Review quant profiles in model registry and pin models that are sensitive to quantization. 2) For Dedicated/Private, set 'applyAutotuneDefaults' in helm values to enable defaults post-upgrade. 3) Add /api/v1/unit_econ webhook to your deployment pipeline to capture suggested policy changes.
testing_summary: Added unit tests for quant profile selector, KV cache TTL behavior, and scheduler batching edge cases. Integration e2e tests simulate high QPS routing and verify cost-savings signals. Canary deployed to 5% of traffic across 2 regions and monitored for latency and quality regressions for 72 hours.
